title: A-15: enforce that every mapped Admin contextual view actually mounts
businessRules: A-15 is canonical in config/product-completeness.json postAuditFindings; closure requires the phase exit criteria and runtime evidence, not marker presence. The finding says the UI audit proves handler presence, not workflow completeness, and it is closed only when a mapped contextual view can no longer stop mounting while every gate stays green.

Measured 2026-10-14: all 70 rows in config/admin-contextual-workflow-map.json carry status SOURCE_IMPLEMENTED, and audit-admin-contextual-workflows.mjs only checks that each renderer name appears in apps/admin/app/page.tsx. Presence in source is not a mounted workflow. The single counterexample is R2HrConfiguration, which was defined but never rendered so /people/attendance and /people/compliance both displayed the payroll lifecycle and all ten panels were unreachable while every gate stayed green.

The fix is enforcement, not more evidence: the existing per-view reachability tests are hand-written one view at a time, so a view that silently unmounts is only caught if somebody happened to write a test for that view.

New invariant: every row in config/admin-contextual-workflow-map.json must map to a renderer that the audit can prove is mounted, not merely referenced. Reachability is part of completeness; a SOURCE_IMPLEMENTED row whose renderer is never mounted must fail the audit.

All data remains tenant isolated by company and branch. The admin contextual map is per-company configuration; this work item does not change tenant or branch authority, does not change any mutation, and does not introduce an idempotency key because nothing is written to business data.

No business logic, API contract, permission, tenant or branch authority, schema, runtime path or gate predicate may be weakened to make this pass. productReady, currentPhase and humanStage20 stay untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: The audit fails if any row in config/admin-contextual-workflow-map.json has a renderer that is not actually mounted in its sourceFile, rather than only present in it.
A dependency-free test proves the negative case: a row whose renderer is absent from the mount site fails, and the same row present at the mount site passes.
The 70 existing rows still pass, so the new invariant reproduces the repository instead of demanding an escape hatch.
tests/hr-r2-configuration-reachability.test.mjs still passes, so the hand-written counterexample class remains covered.
productReady, currentPhase and humanStage20 stay untouched, and the finding status moves to RUNTIME_VERIFIED only with runtime evidence.
Both GitHub heavy workflows and Workflow Governance stay green on the exact commit.
testPlan: GitHub exact-source Full Automated UAT and Full System Simulation
migrationPlan: No schema migration. Only the audit script, one dependency-free test, and the finding evidence change; no database object is added, altered or dropped.
rollbackPlan: Revert the commit. The audit returns to presence-only checking and the mount-enforcement test disappears; nothing else changes and no data is written. The prior green commit remains a valid checkpoint.
monitoringPlan: The mount-enforcement control runs inside the dependency-free suite on every local run and on both heavy workflows, so a view that silently unmounts fails the build rather than quietly degrading the operator surface.
securityNotes: No secret, token, credential or personal data appears in any file this work item edits, and none may be introduced. Tenant and branch authority are unchanged; this is an audit-strength change only.
